dct_title_s: Asia : China--East Coast. Taichow Liehtao and approaches
dct_description_sm: From a Chinese survey in 1931 ; published at the Hydrographic Office, Washington, D.C., Nov. 1944 under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings and tints; relief by contours and spot heights.
Shows low water areas, reefs, buildings.
